demo.note: A shared sandbox account for the 'Try the demo' button. Public on purpose: it holds only invented data, and the sample case is created fresh on each sign-in. Not a secret, and not a real mailbox.

note: OAuth 2.0 Web client ID from Google Cloud (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com). It is public by design; never put a client secret here. Steps: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, 'Optional: Gmail discovery'.
